issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not contain the phrase 'đều bị bỏ hoang' (all are abandoned/desolate). The clause 'כִּי עַל כָּל בָּתֵּי מָשׂוֹשׂ קִרְיָה עַלִּיזָה' means 'for upon all the houses of joy, the jubilant city' — it describes the joyful houses and the jubilant city as the location where thorns come up, not that they are abandoned. The Vietnamese adds a concept of abandonment/desolation that is not present in the Hebrew.
